text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a display undoubtedly deserving of the nickname "the Beast," Narita Brian wins the Kikuka Sho and is crowned Triple Crown Champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Hishi Amazon has just become Triple Tiara Champion. The two of them reaffirm their intentions to battle at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, Narita Brian sets her sights on the Arima Kinen to settle the score with Hishi Amazon!
